required_inputs: Frozen public PWR/SB-LOCA manifest with labels, trajectory IDs, counts, units, sampling rate, horizon, and break-extent targets.
Independent trajectory- and scenario-level train, validation, and held-out partitions with declared known and unknown-scenario identities.
Physics-derived residual or conservation feature schema with unit labels.
P-NEML-F01-D1-MANIFEST, P-NEML-F01-D1-SPLIT, P-NEML-F01-D1-DOMAIN, and P-NEML-F01-D1-PHYSICS preflight records, all blocking before fitting.
Matched temporal regression baseline and one bounded candidate sharing the frozen split, temporal backbone, seed, horizon, preprocessing provenance, and inherited resource ceiling.
Declared held-out calibration procedure, unknown-scenario/OOD boundary, code identity, and resource-log format.
incompatible_conditions: Invalid or untraceable provenance, non-public inputs, unavailable labels or targets, missing units or horizon, or ambiguous target-domain labels.
Non-independent partitions, any trajectory or scenario identifier overlap, unresolved leakage, or calibration-set reuse.
Missing required physics-derived residual or conservation features or unit labels.
Any unresolved required precondition or absent known-versus-unknown scenario boundary.
Unsupported deployment, plant control, protection, maintenance-deferral, licensing, or operational-safety use, or unavailable qualified specialist safety review.

assumptions: The observational unit, target population, sampling mechanism, break-extent target, units, horizon, missingness, and dependence are fixed before partitioning.
Public simulated PWR/SB-LOCA data are the only evidence source; simulator output is not plant evidence and plant validity is not inferred.
Preprocessing and calibration are fitted only on training data; the baseline and candidate use identical frozen partitions, seed, backbone, horizon, and ceilings.
Physics-derived features have declared dimensions but their physical adequacy, transfer, and generalization remain hypotheses until separately tested and reviewed.
baselines: Matched temporal regression on the identical frozen split and resource ceiling.
A persistence or constant/mean reference is an analytic sanity baseline only and adds no learned fit.
controls: Use the identical frozen split, temporal backbone, seed, horizon, and inherited resource ceiling for baseline and candidate.
Predeclare physics-feature removal and shuffled-label diagnostics as replacement or leakage checks that add no fit beyond the inherited ceiling.
procedure_outline: Read the manifest, labels, sampling rate, horizon, partition identities, and physics-feature schema before any fit; stop on a failed precondition.
After every preflight passes, fit one matched baseline and one bounded candidate within the inherited ceilings, with training-only preprocessing and frozen controls.
Score every bound metric once on the untouched held-out data and apply the copied Go, Stop, or Pivot criteria mechanically.
Keep this outline advisory; do not execute training, inference, deployment, or operational use through method coaching.
uncertainty_handling: Report held-out calibration behavior without calibration-set reuse and separate sampling, label, measurement, model, optimization, and distribution-shift uncertainty.
Report entity-, scenario-, time-, and slice-level variation within the inherited fit and resource ceilings; preserve unfavorable repeats and treat simulator-to-plant uncertainty as unresolved.
Do not treat correlated windows, trajectories, or augmented samples as independent replicates.
validation_checks: Verify manifest completeness, zero identifier overlap, identical controls, numeric resource logs, physics-feature units, and no operational extrapolation.
Audit trajectory-, scenario-, and time-aware split independence and training-only preprocessing; preserve negative, unstable, and unsupported slices.
Check calibration, unknown-scenario/OOD behavior, distribution-shift sensitivity, and error slices under identical partitions and budgets.
Derived Go coverage is MAE >= 5.0 percent, ECE <= 0.08 fraction, and N >= 30 count; use only the copied finite route criteria.

Keep code verification, solution verification, validation, UQ, ML evaluation, target-domain transfer, operational qualification, and safety credit separate; offline contract validation is not nuclear-safety validation.
failure_modes: Trajectory, scenario, entity, temporal, preprocessing, label, future-information, or calibration leakage can make held-out error, calibration, or eligible-count evidence falsely favorable.
Missing labels, units, horizons, or target definitions can corrupt break-extent error and eligible-data coverage.
Shortcut learning, confounding, break-extent imbalance, simulator shift, or prevalence shift can fail on the claimed target distribution.
Missing or dimensionally inconsistent physics features can invalidate the hybrid contribution and create non-conservative errors.
Overfitting, unstable optimization, miscalibration, or OOD overconfidence can make results non-reproducible or unsafe to interpret.
Resource overrun, extra fits, or unlogged preprocessing invalidates the inherited route contract.
safety_boundaries: Use only public or open simulated PWR/SB-LOCA data; no private plant data, new physical experiments, or operational data are in scope.
No plant control, operational safety conclusion, service, deployment, protection credit, licensing acceptance, or maintenance-deferral decision is authorized.

Preserve deterministic protections, interlocks, conservative rules, defense in depth, and human authority; require qualified independent nuclear, VVUQ, ML, I&C, human-factors, cybersecurity, radiation-protection, and safety review before consequential use.
Method coaching does not acquire or upload data, train or run models, allocate compute, start services, deploy systems, or issue operational decisions.
